about: The editor's browser suites in shards: dev/ci_shards.py runs a shard and gates them, dev/ci_balance.py deals the commands to shards by their p95 (seconds) from main's records. Every command runs in test/.

serve.py.why: a helper: the server the suites start (and npm run serve)

git_server.py.why: a helper: the git http-backend git.py starts

pages.py.why: a helper: Cloudflare Pages' serving, which ux.py and offline.py start (and npm run serve:app)

word_fixture.py.why: a helper: writes test/fixtures/word-*.docx, which npm test reads

word_lo.py.why: a helper: word.py's LibreOffice side, where LibreOffice is installed

stress.py.why: holds keystroke times to limits a shared runner may miss: run by hand

loadbench.py.why: a benchmark, one build against another: run by hand or through suite.yml (AGENTS.md)

scripts.py.why: not in CI before the shards either (AGENTS.md: run by hand for direction, the page's fonts or scripts.js); adding it is its own change

corpus_browser.py.why: needs the LaTeX-examples corpus: run by hand (AGENTS.md)

editor_corpus.py.why: every scripted edit on the corpus, an hour: run by hand (AGENTS.md)
